# Universal Screen Space Reflection source

Vendored from <https://github.com/mseonKim/URP-ScreenSpaceReflection> at commit
`57023e2fd8f19621dc37c65426e42531307b1478` (package version 1.1.0).

The upstream Unity Companion License is preserved in `LICENSE.md`.

Project integration:

- Renderer: `Assets/Settings/PC_Renderer.asset`
- Volume profile: `Assets/Settings/SampleSceneProfile.asset`
- Forward+ water material: `Assets/FPGDemo/Presentation/Level/Environment/rootArt/root1/Water.mat`
- The previous `Assets/URP_SSR` renderer feature remains in the project but is inactive.
